newsitem.title: USA: D&P downgrades Turkey foreign currency obligations.
newsitem.headline: D&P downgrades Turkey foreign currency obligations.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it downgraded the rating of the foreign currency obligations of the Republic of Turkey to Double B Minus from Double B.
It also revised Turkey's rating outlook to stable from negative.

The downgrade is the result of the accumulation of negative macroeconomic trends, continuing fiscal imbalances and a lack of concerted policy action to address underlying structural weaknesses over the past year, Duff & Phelps said.
Turkey's rating downgrade reflects the widening of the consolidated fiscal deficit and public sector borrowing requirement to 8.8 percent and 9.6 percent of GNP in 1996, the rating agency said.
